_doc: NCM Gearbox 0.4.0: manual.band.slices (1..7, default 7) -- each selected gear is cut across that many of the clone's seven native gears (same rpm line, each slice the model's own torque at its speed, no native shift gap); 1 = the old one-gear band. 0.3.1 (L306 phase 3). manual.band (0.3.1, live): each shift sets the native gear's rpm window so the speed you land at after an upshift plays landingRpm and the gear's limiter plays redlineRpm (minRpmFloor clamps the computed minimum, which goes below zero on close ratios; set it to 0 if the engine misbehaves). manual.engineAudioScale default band (0.3.0, experiment): we write NO sound value; each shift moves the clone's one native gear's top speed to the selected gear's limiter, so the game's own engine and sound sweep idle to redline across each gear. PAGEUP cycles band / curve / blend / rpm / limiter / fraction / off (the others restore the full native gear). The HUD line under the rev bar shows the live curve values, warns FOLLOW 100% (follow 1 means the game's own rpm only: the curve is off), and shows CONFIG ERROR if a save did not parse (JSON numbers cannot start with 0, e.g. 01111111). THIS FILE IS RE-READ WHILE THE GAME RUNS (0.2.8): edit, save, keep driving. manual.engineAudioScale default curve (0.2.8): one continuous engine-sound value -- manual.curve.lo..hi rpm across each gear, shaped by gamma (>1 stays low longer and climbs hard near the limiter), pulled follow (0..1) toward the game's own rpm, slewed over smoothMs. blend (0.2.7): each frame writes one of manual.blend.layers (quietest first; off = leave the game its own value), sliding from the quietest at a gear's floor to the loudest at its limiter, every layer at least manual.blend.floor of the mix. manual.audioCycleKey (0.2.6, default PAGEUP): cycles the engine-sound scale live while driving a manual -- rpm, limiter, fraction, off -- shown on the HUD and logged with a once-a-second trace. manual.upKey / manual.downKey: the shift keys (LSHIFT, LCTRL, RSHIFT, RCTRL, LALT, UP, DOWN, PAGEUP, PAGEDOWN, TAB, CAPSLOCK, MOUSE4, MOUSE5, or one letter/digit). manual.engineAudioScale: what veh_engine_rpm gets, in rpm units like the game feeds it -- rpm (default, 0.2.5: idle to the model's own shift rpm) | limiter (idle to the top gear's limiter; 0.2.3, sounded like redline) | fraction (0..1; 0.2.4, sounded mute) | off. manual.engineAudio: drive the engine sound with the virtual revs and gear (false = the game's own one long sweep). manual.padUp / manual.padDown: Xbox pad buttons (A, B, X, Y, LB, RB, LS, RS, DPADUP, DPADDOWN, DPADLEFT, DPADRIGHT, BACK, START, NONE). The rest is the S2 instrument, OFF: never write the native gear (KB-330: it crashed the game). observe: log the player's car's gear-like fields against the HUD gear. hold.field: the integer field to write every frame (EMPTY = never write anything); hold.gear: the gear to hold. Fill hold.field only from a name the census or the observe lines printed. hold.path: an address path the scan printed. hold.trial (0.1.2, dev): once the scan settles, hold the current gear in each survivor for 6 s in turn and log what the car does. hold.ab (0.1.3, dev): on hold.path, alternate a frame-write hold (A) with a frame + physics-step hold (B), 6 s each, twice, and count how often the automatic fought it.
